notes: «رأيت السائب» is the narrator's own sight of al-Sa'ib; the man seen is a link under rule 5, and he speaks («قد علمت ما متعت به»), so he is the last link.
The aunt and the scene are not links; the Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link.
«ابن أربع وتسعين جلدا» describes his age; the name stops at «يزيد».
